name: pre-award-agent
description: Create a federal SOW or PWS and carry its approved scope directly into the correct IGCE workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Build a SOW or PWS and the matching IGCE
interface.longDescription: Coordinates scope-only, pricing-only, and end-to-end federal pre-award workflows. It preserves approved handoffs, routes FFP, LH/T&M, and cost-reimbursement work to separate pricing methods, and keeps the contract document separate from the Government estimate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $pre-award-workflow to build a SOW or PWS and carry its approved handoff into the correctly routed IGCE.
